hook_line: INDIA'S FIRST BULLET TRAIN RUNS IN LATE 2027

hook_stat.sub: First bullet train service in the last quarter of 2027, Surat-Vapi section first

stats.label: Kilometres of pier work completed as of September
Design speed in kmph of the indigenous B28 trainset

diaspora_bullets: The full 508 km corridor to Mumbai will follow in phases
Fares, a timetable and a booking channel have not been announced
news_summary: India's first high-speed rail service will commence in the last quarter of 2027, with the Surat-Vapi section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor opening first.
payoff: For travellers, nothing can be booked yet: the first service is a Gujarat section, not a Mumbai-Ahmedabad through journey.
